Thanks for sending the latest order form. Legal flagged the publicity / reference rights language and a couple of confidentiality carveouts we need clarified before procurement can sign. High-level asks from our side:

- We need to confirm whether Redwood intends to include customer logo and short case quote in outbound marketing and if so, the approval workflow and pre-release review window.

- We also need a short list of the evidence items you can provide for SOC2 / data handling and any marketing asset usage examples (e.g., approved logos, co-branded templates).

Attached: acme_orderform_v3_redline.docx (redlines from our contracts team). Ben and our legal team are on copy; please loop in your legal/marketing so we can close these points in this sprint.

Cheers,
Anna

3) Logo usage: Marissa will provide our logo guidelines; Acme's logo pack should be uploaded to the shared drive for co-brand templates.
4) Evidence & escrow: we can deposit final approved press assets (graphics, PDFs) to a mutually accessible Google Drive folder and produce a timestamped audit trail. For compliance evidence (SOC2 report excerpts, data retention statements) Kimberly will confirm what is shareable.

Attached: redlines_summary.pdf — I've summarized Acme's redline and bullets for internal owners. Marissa — once Kimberly signs off, can you confirm the format you need for logo/asset delivery?

Team — quick draft positions from legal to keep the OF/MSA tidy and low-friction:

1) Publicity/reference clause: allow Redwood to use Acme's name and a short (max 100 words) descriptive customer reference in marketing materials, provided Acme signs off on the specific wording prior to publication.
2) Quote/case excerpt: any customer-identifying quote limited to 1-2 sentences for public materials; any quote longer than that remains subject to Acme's written approval.
3) Logo usage: Acme to provide approved logos; Redwood will adhere to Acme brand guidelines and will only use icons/logos supplied in the accepted pack. Any co-branded materials will be pre-approved.
4) Approval workflow: Acme review within 1 business day for single approver; up to 3 business days if multiple approvers listed. If no response within the window, use is permitted only for non-identifying collateral (logo inclusion without a quote).
5) Embargo and escrow: For launch-day PR, both parties must mutually agree on the embargo date in writing. We can support depositing final assets into a shared folder; Redwood will maintain an audit log with timestamps.

I attach a short snippet illustrating the proposed OF language (confidentiality_redline_snippet.docx). Highlights: keep the carveout narrow, require pre-approval for any identifying quote and require an approver email address in the order form.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
